title: Q-LESSON-DEPLOY-VERSION: A deploy is verified by the version it reports
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/handoff.js::min_version
**Status:** closed

LESSONS-1 (2026-11-16): from the failure-mode register of the fleet this org was split from (638 entries, classified by root cause).

36 failure modes were deploy and version drift: merges never deployed, exact-string version probes, migrations re-applied when a file was edited.

Path: seed/worker/src/handoff.js

Acceptance: after a deploy handoff.js reads /health and requires the reported version to be at least the expected one, else rolls back; the migration runner refuses an applied file whose sha256 changed; both covered in seed/worker/test.

size: S

**Closing probe:** grep:seed/worker/src/handoff.js::min_version

**Evidence:** handoff.js meetsVersion (min_version for dotted versions, deployment id must differ from the one live before the deploy) checked through makeVersionReader (site /__internal/version) after every deploy; a mismatch rolls back through the existing rollback path and never self-heals; deploy/migration-plan.mjs marks an applied file whose sha256 changed as drift and apply-d1-migrations.mjs does not re-run it. Tests: seed/worker/test/handoff.test.js (meetsVersion, version rollback, version pass), seed/worker/test/migrations.test.js.
